title: Config, which is building a data layer for robotics foundation models, raised a $27M seed at a $200M+ valuation led by Samsung Venture Investment (Kate Park/TechCrunch)
summary: Kate Park / TechCrunch: Config, which is building a data layer for robotics foundation models, raised a $27M seed at a $200M+ valuation led by Samsung Venture Investment — Asia's push into physical AI is being fueled by the same manufacturing prowess that made the region a global industrial powerhouse.
